title: Correct final velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the velocity at t=3 s as 15 m/s using kinematic equations.

title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the kinetic friction coefficient as 0.75 using Newton's second law.

title: Correct stopping distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the additional distance moved after force removal as 15 m.

title: Acceleration from kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student should determine the constant acceleration (5 m/s²) from the given displacement and time.

title: Free-body diagram setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly resolve forces and write Newton's second law in both x and y directions.

title: Post-removal deceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the deceleration after force removal using only friction.

title: Kinematic equation application
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show proper use of v² = u² + 2as or equivalent for the deceleration phase.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses incorrect sign for friction force or misapplies Newton's second law.

title: Normal force mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the normal force (e.g., ignoring vertical component of applied force).
